verdicts.reason: A: the elements use three different left edges. The quote mark sits at about x55, the quote text at about x27 and the attribution is indented at about x50. The attribution is jammed under the last line of the quote and runs into the top edge of the circle. The logo sits inside the circle, which muddies the layering. B: the quote mark, quote text, attribution and logo all share one clean left edge, and the can and circle keep their bottom-right placement from the original. However, 'soon.' is left as a one-word last line, the logo is crammed right under the attribution with no breathing room, and there is a large empty band in the middle left.
